product_updates.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
product_updates.content: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.

product_updates.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
product_updates.content: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
